prompt: RimWorld building sprite, seen from above at the game's slight top-down angle so the desk top fills the frame and only a thin strip of its dark front edge shows at the bottom. A dark grey steel desk crowded edge to edge with radio equipment, almost no bare desk visible: a boxy VHF transceiver with a blank blue display and large tuning knob, a second receiver stacked beside it, a power supply with an amber light, a desk microphone on a stand, a coiled handset cable, a headset, a log book and a few loose papers, a short whip antenna standing at one back corner.
